title: God Files Refactor Phase 4 - Frontend Planning Controller And View Decomposition
goal: Decompose usePlanningController and PlanningView into slice-owned hooks and tab-owned containers while preserving route behavior and current UI capabilities.

global_context.existing_capability_lock: Do not add new tabs, new data fields, or new UI behavior. Preserve current planning, arcs, and tab workflows.

tasks.title: Add failing tests for the new planning slice hooks and PlanningView container split
tasks.objective: Create failing frontend tests that lock the target planning slice hook import surfaces and the existence of the new view container modules.
repo_context: Target slice hooks are useSequencePlanning.ts, useChapterPlanning.ts, useScenePlanning.ts, useBeatPlanning.ts, useChapterPackets.ts, useStoryboardPlanning.ts, useArcPlanning.ts, and usePlanningRetries.ts.
Target view modules are frontend/src/views/planning/PlanningTabShell.tsx plus tab containers and shared coordination-only hooks.
implementation_notes: Write import and minimal behavior tests that fail until the new modules exist.
Do not assert new user-facing behavior.

verification.red: cd frontend && npm run test -- usePlanningSlices
verification.expected_red: FAIL because the new slice hook and view container modules do not exist yet

guardrails: Do not create tests for tabs or hooks that are not in the approved design spec.
Do not change current planning behavior expectations.
tasks.review_before_complete: Confirm the tests are structural and compatibility-focused, not feature-expanding.

tasks.title: Extract focused planning slice hooks and form hooks
tasks.objective: Use useSequencePlanning.ts as the first extraction anchor, then create the other planning slice and form hooks defined by the design spec.
repo_context: Current usePlanningController owns PlanningTabState, PlanningTabCallbacks, many useQueries calls, and many form state fields.
The design spec requires explicit source-of-truth ownership for sequence, chapter, scene, beat, packet, storyboard, and arc concerns.
Form hooks must own modal open state and local draft field state only for the owning feature.
implementation_notes: Create the slice hooks and form hooks under frontend/src/domains/planning/ and frontend/src/domains/planning/forms/.
Keep query keys, mutation semantics, and invalidation behavior consistent with current code.
Do not add new Zustand state or duplicate derived data.

verification.green: cd frontend && npm run test -- usePlanningController
verification.expected_green: existing planning controller tests continue to pass while the new slice hooks exist

guardrails: Do not change service calls away from existing frontend services.
Do not add new hook return fields that the current UI does not need.
tasks.review_before_complete: Check each slice hook and confirm it has one source of truth and one feature area.

tasks.title: Reduce usePlanningController to a thin compatibility composition hook
tasks.objective: Refactor usePlanningController so it composes the slice hooks without owning new business logic or duplicated state.
repo_context: usePlanningController currently returns { state, callbacks } and is consumed by PlanningView, usePlanningTab, and PlanningTab.
The architecture spec allows it to remain only as a thin compatibility adapter.
implementation_notes: Preserve the current public return shape so existing consumers keep working during the transition.
Remove inline ownership where the same data now belongs to a slice hook.
Do not add new orchestration logic.

verification.green: cd frontend && npm run test -- usePlanningController
verification.expected_green: planning controller tests pass with the controller acting as a compatibility composition layer

guardrails: Do not widen PlanningTabState or PlanningTabCallbacks.
Do not keep duplicate local state once a slice hook owns it.
tasks.review_before_complete: Read the entire hook and confirm it is composition-only.

tasks.title: Extract PlanningView tab containers and shared coordination-only workflows
tasks.objective: Use PlanningTabShell.tsx as the first view extraction anchor, then create the tab containers and shared coordination hooks defined in the design spec.
repo_context: Current PlanningView owns activeTab, character selection, relationship editing, discovery scan workflow, multiple queries, and direct usePlanningController consumption.
The design spec requires shared hooks under frontend/src/views/planning/shared/ to be coordination-only.
The current PlanningTab component consumes state and callbacks and should keep working during the split.
implementation_notes: Create PlanningCoreTab.tsx, FlowTab.tsx, ArcsTab.tsx, BranchesTab.tsx, DecisionsTab.tsx, CheckerTab.tsx, BrainstormTab.tsx, FoundationTab.tsx, CharactersTab.tsx, WorldBibleTab.tsx, and RelationshipsTab.tsx.
Create shared coordination hooks only for tab navigation, character selection, relationship editing, and discovery scan workflow.
Do not let shared hooks perform direct API calls if a domain hook already owns the data.

green: cd frontend && npm run test -- usePlanningController

guardrails: Do not change routes or tabs.
Do not introduce new global UI state.
Do not let shared hooks become new data ownership layers.
tasks.review_before_complete: Inspect PlanningView and the new shared hooks and confirm the shell owns only route-level composition.

phase_completion_requirements.mandatory_review: Run a code review on the frontend planning decomposition before phase completion.
mandatory_verification: cd frontend && npm run test -- usePlanningController
